generator.prompt: A Roman ballista, a heavy two-armed torsion stone-thrower: a massive square timber frame holding two vertical bundles of twisted rope springs bound with iron, two thick wooden arms joined by a bowstring, a long timber trough with a winch at the back, the whole engine standing on a low sturdy timber platform; about two and a half metres long and one point six metres high. Weathered timber, rope and dark iron. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
